name: MonarchAiFeedback
title: AiFeedback
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedIconToggleButton (with an icon) or androidx.compose.material3.FilterChip for the thumbs; androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet with MonarchCheckboxGroup, MonarchTextField (multi-line), MonarchInlineNotice and MonarchButton
summary: Thumbs up and down for an AI answer, then reasons and an optional comment in a sheet, then a thank-you.
whenToUse: Under an AI answer, to collect a rating and, for a bad answer, why it was bad.
whenNotToUse: For a star or number rating, use MonarchRatingPicker. For a long survey, use a form screen.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiFeedback(selection: MonarchAiMessageFeedback?, onSelectionChange: (MonarchAiMessageFeedback?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, reasons: Map<MonarchAiMessageFeedback, List<MonarchCheckboxGroupOption<String>>>? = null, asksDetails: MonarchAiFeedbackDetails = MonarchAiFeedbackDetails.Down, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable (value: MonarchAiMessageFeedback, checked: Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiFeedbackLabels = MonarchAiFeedbackLabels(), onSubmit: (suspend (MonarchAiFeedbackSubmission) -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchAiFeedbackDetails { Down, Both, None }
data class MonarchAiFeedbackSubmission(value: MonarchAiMessageFeedback, reasons: List<String>, comment: String)

class MonarchAiFeedbackLabels(group: String? = null, good: String? = null, bad: String? = null, reasonsDown: String? = null, reasonsUp: String? = null, comment: String? = null, commentPlaceholder: String? = null, submit: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, thanks: String? = null, error: String? = null)

options.name: selection
options.description: The rating, null for none. It changes as soon as a thumb is pressed, before anything is sent.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the new rating, or null when the pressed thumb is pressed again.

options.name: reasons
options.description: The reasons offered for each rating; null offers Inaccurate, Not helpful, Incomplete, Hard to follow and Harmful or unsafe after a thumbs down and none after a thumbs up.

options.name: asksDetails
options.description: Which ratings open the sheet; the others are sent at once.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the thumbs can be pressed.

options.name: icon
options.description: The thumb glyph, given the rating and whether it is pressed; null shows each thumb as a chip with its name.

options.name: onSubmit
options.description: Sends the rating, the chosen reason ids in listed order and the trimmed comment. Throw to show the error.

states.name: rated
states.description: The chosen thumb is checked (icon toggle) or selected (chip with a check mark); with an icon, the app can show a filled glyph.

states.name: details
states.description: A sheet with the title, the question and reasons as checkboxes, the comment, Cancel and Send feedback.

states.name: sending
states.description: Send feedback shows progress; the sheet cannot be dismissed and the thumbs are disabled.

states.name: thanks
states.description: "Thanks for your feedback." under the thumbs, announced.

states.name: error
states.description: The send threw: a danger notice in the sheet, which stays filled in, or the error under the thumbs after a direct send, announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The thumbs use the disabled colors and do nothing.

appearance: Material 3 outlined icon toggle buttons or filter chips in Monarch's theme; the sheet uses the raised surface with the checkbox group, text field and buttons in their own appearance. The thank-you is muted caption text and the error danger-strong caption text. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web shows the reasons as chips and the form inline under the thumbs; as on iOS, the form is a modal bottom sheet and the reasons are a MonarchCheckboxGroup. Monarch bundles no icons, so the thumb glyphs come from the icon slot; without them each thumb is a FilterChip with its name, so meaning never depends on a glyph. Pressed thumbs use the Material toggle colors where the web uses the AI colors. The rating type is MonarchAiMessageFeedback, shared with MonarchAiConversation. The web moves focus to the thank-you; Android announces it through a polite live region because the sheet closes. onSubmit is a suspend function that throws in place of a promise. The web's uncontrolled mode is not offered: selection is hoisted. iOS uses a Binding and a trailing onSubmit closure; Android hoists selection with onSelectionChange and keeps onSubmit last. Experimental: an AI product composite that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: Each thumb is a Material toggle (icon button, with on or off state) or a selectable chip, named "Good response" or "Bad response"; the thumbs are a traversal group named "Rate this response".
Thumbs and sheet buttons have touch targets of at least 48dp.
In the sheet the title is a heading, the reasons are labelled checkboxes under the question and the comment has a visible label.
The thank-you and the error under the thumbs are one always-present polite live region; the error in the sheet is a polite notice.
The pressed state is a toggle state or a chip's check mark, not color alone.
edgeCases: Pressing the pressed thumb again clears the rating and closes any sheet without sending.
A rating with no reasons shows only the comment in the sheet.
Without onSubmit, ratings still change and the thank-you shows.
A send cancelled by leaving the screen is not shown as an error.
Reason ids that are not offered are left out of the submission.

examples.title: Default (details on thumbs down)
examples.setupTemplate:
var rating by remember { mutableStateOf<MonarchAiMessageFeedback?>(null) }
var sent by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
examples.setup:
var rating by remember { mutableStateOf<MonarchAiMessageFeedback?>(null) }
var sent by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

examples.title: Custom reasons for both ratings, with icons
examples.code:
MonarchAiFeedback(
    selection = rating,
    onSelectionChange = { rating = it },
    reasons = mapOf(
        MonarchAiMessageFeedback.Up to listOf(MonarchCheckboxGroupOption("clear", "Clear")),
        MonarchAiMessageFeedback.Down to listOf(MonarchCheckboxGroupOption("wrong", "Wrong")),
    ),
    asksDetails = MonarchAiFeedbackDetails.Both,
    icon = { value, _ ->
        val glyph = if (value == MonarchAiMessageFeedback.Up) SampleIcons.ThumbUp else SampleIcons.ThumbDown
        Icon(glyph, contentDescription = null)
    },
)
